Home.gdprWhatMeansTitle: What does this mean for you and your personal data?
Home.gdprWhatMeansText: Your personal data is any information that relates to you and on the basis of which you are identifiable to us as a natural person. This occurs in cases where we can identify you directly or indirectly, in particular on the basis of a generally applicable identifier or other identifier, such as name, surname, identification number, location data or online identifier. Personal data therefore includes in particular contact details of a natural person, their IP address, may be information about the use of services or about activities and preferences of a natural person.
Home.gdprDataCollectedText: During your visit to our website, we record the IP address assigned to you by your internet provider, from which websites you visited our site, how long you stayed on our site, which specific subpages you view, and more. This information is considered personal data as it is your online identifier, and therefore we handle this data with increased care.

BivajArt.title: Bivaj Art Luthery
BivajArt.subtitle: High-quality musical instruments from Transylvania
BivajArt.intro: We present to you our high-quality musical instruments, which are made by two craftsmen Vajai Ferenc and Biro István (old boys) of the "Bivaj" workshop in Transylvania. Our main profile is the making of the double bass, but we are also happy to create cellos, viola da gambas, or violins, which evoke the world of early music. Our instruments are made based on unique designs and implementations, which is also confirmed by our special internal label and certificate of authenticity.
BivajArt.materials: The raw materials we use come from the Carpathians, where they dry naturally for several years. The top of the instrument is made of carefully selected resonance wood, while the back, sides and neck are made of curly maple, the back consists of two parts. The fingerboard and string holder are made of ebony, and the leg is made of carefully selected maple.
BivajArt.craftsmanship: These instruments are made with care and love, completely by hand, through many years of mastery. Lacquering with an antique effect is the specialty of our workshop, which consists of Joha spirit-based varnish and natural resin made according to our own recipe. This special lacquering technique contributes to the beautiful and flexible sound of the instruments. We also pay special attention to handmade artistic bass keys and mechanisms, which also represent unique solutions.
BivajArt.conclusion: Our workshop offers selectable and ready-to-play stringed instruments that provide perfect sound and quality for orchestral or solo performances. Each 'Bivaj' instrument is a handcrafted, unique work of art that represents the highest standards of craftsmanship and offers rich, satisfying tonal complexity.
